27	  AUTO_THEME_NAME,
28	  CUSTOM_THEME_AUTO_NAME,
29	  CUSTOM_THEME_DARK_NAME,
30	  CUSTOM_THEME_LIGHT_NAME,
31	  darkTheme,
32	  getThemeSelectionFromThemeConfig,
33	  lightTheme,
34	  ThemeConfig,

40	interface ThemeOptionConfig {
41	  label: ThemeSelection
42	  icon: string
43	}

45	const THEME_OPTIONS: ThemeOptionConfig[] = [
46	  { label: "System", icon: ":material/contrast:" },
47	  { label: "Light", icon: ":material/light_mode:" },
48	  { label: "Dark", icon: ":material/dark_mode:" },
49	]

51	/**
52	 * Finds the theme matching a given selection from the available themes.
53	 * Handles both preset themes (Light, Dark, Auto) and custom theme variants.
54	 */
55	export function findThemeForSelection(
56	  selection: ThemeSelection,
57	  availableThemes: ThemeConfig[]
58	): ThemeConfig | undefined {
59	  switch (selection) {
60	    case "System":
61	      return availableThemes.find(
62	        theme =>
63	          theme.name === CUSTOM_THEME_AUTO_NAME ||
64	          theme.name === AUTO_THEME_NAME
65	      )
66	    case "Light":
67	      return availableThemes.find(
68	        theme =>
69	          theme.name === CUSTOM_THEME_LIGHT_NAME ||
70	          theme.name === lightTheme.name
71	      )
72	    case "Dark":
73	      return availableThemes.find(
74	        theme =>
75	          theme.name === CUSTOM_THEME_DARK_NAME ||
76	          theme.name === darkTheme.name
77	      )
78	  }
79	}
80	
81	/**
82	 * Builds the theme selection section as radio items.
83	 * Returns [] when:
84	 * - No themes are available (nothing to switch between)
85	 * - Only a single custom theme is available (no light/dark variants)
86	 */
87	export function buildThemeSection(
88	  activeTheme: ThemeConfig,
89	  availableThemes: ThemeConfig[],
90	  setTheme: (theme: ThemeConfig) => void,
91	  metricsMgr: MetricsManager
92	): MenuSection {
93	  // Hide when there is nothing to switch between.
94	  // availableThemes is either 3 (preset or custom light/dark/auto) or 1 (single
95	  // custom theme with no light/dark variants).
96	  if (availableThemes.length <= 1) {
97	    return []
98	  }
99	
100	  const activeSelection = getThemeSelectionFromThemeConfig(activeTheme)
101	
102	  return THEME_OPTIONS.map(option => ({
103	    type: "radio" as const,
104	    key: `theme-${option.label}`,
105	    label: option.label,
106	    icon: option.icon,
107	    checked: activeSelection === option.label,
108	    onSelect: () => {
109	      const newTheme = findThemeForSelection(option.label, availableThemes)
110	      if (newTheme) {
111	        metricsMgr.enqueue("menuClick", { label: "changeTheme" })
112	        setTheme(newTheme)
113	      }
114	    },
115	  }))
116	}
